aspiration: Become a world-leading adaptive trading research AI that continuously learns to seek sustainable positive risk-adjusted net profitability across eligible strategies and markets.
impossible_guarantee_rejected: Never assume or promise that every trade will be profitable, that adaptation must recover losses, or that the system is the best in the world without reproducible comparisons.

architecture.meta_model: Separate ninth supervisory research component; only offline evaluated; no production adaptation or real trading
architecture.abstention: No trade is a valid and preferred decision whenever validated expected net benefit is uncertain or nonpositive
architecture.adaptation: learn from timestamped completed outcomes; differentiate changing market regimes from noise; replay and compare each new candidate against immutable frozen baseline
architecture.rollback: preserve prior immutable model versions; reject or rollback deteriorating candidates
architecture.scalping_note: Separate dedicated adaptive scalping candidate, not conflated with existing auction; requires independent venue execution-cost evidence

primary_goal.metric: positive independent forward net expectancy per executed or fully specified paper trade, after verified trading costs, adjusted for statistical uncertainty
risk_controls: no retraining on protected forward test records
model changes do not automatically alter production
primary_goal.benchmark: unchanged seven INVO website engines, plus independently defined simple market baselines
primary_goal.evidence_policy: New predictions must be preregistered and captured in actual time; missing polls are gaps, not backfilled opportunities; simulated returns and directional scores never become live PnL.
primary_goal.gating: At least 100 aggregate forward closed trades and 30 per candidate-market group for first inspection; not alone sufficient for promotion; dependence/multiple-testing corrections and separate manual review required.

prohibited_actions: claiming guaranteed profit or 100% win rate
using future information to generate prior signals
development_priority: continue independent v9 forward profitability evidence
v10 immutable model and data provenance
concept drift detection with minimum sample and rollback
independent review before any authorized release
launch_criteria: Research-only until independent forward economic evidence and explicit user authorization for production changes.
